author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am pushing to automate the model evaluation harness. Right now, manually running the test suite for every new weather feature takes days, which stalls the entire iteration cycle. I need a pipeline that spins up fresh evaluations the moment I push a candidate model. The more rapid feedback loops I have, the better I can isolate the heatwave signal from the noise. Faster testing means I can iterate on the seasonal article forecasts without waiting on a queue. I want to see the impact of the new weather feed on residual stock predictions within hours, not weeks. This speed is the only way we will catch the drift before the next promotion week hits the shelves.
output.reclassify_reason: The author states a need for rapid feedback loops and explicitly notes that having faster testing and more rapid iterations would make them happier and more effective in isolating signals.
